affliction.description: This widespread illness can sweep through entire communities, leaving few unaffected. The first indication of the disease is a telltale swelling of glands. In some cases, the disease can move into your lungs (pneumonic plague) or blood (septicemic plague), which is even more fatal. If you have bubonic plague, you can’t remove the fatigued condition while affected.
affliction.name: Bubonic Plague

stages.effect: enfeebled 3, fatigued, and take 1d6 persistent bleed damage every 1d20 minutes
stages.name: Stage 3

traits.name: Disease
traits.text: An effect with this trait applies one or more diseases. A disease is typically an affliction.
